column1: # Rows whose PROVINCE ATTRIBUTION is stated by the page but not recoverable
# from the table's geometry alone, verified by hand against the page.
# The early layout prints the province as a merged cell spanning its zones, and
# the grid records only the row that cell's text happens to centre on. The
# carry fills the rest by taking the nearest printed label, and at a block
# boundary the nearest label can be the wrong block's: on sitrep 009, Rwampara
# sits two rows from Nord-Kivu's label and three from Ituri's, so 32 Ituri
# cases entered Nord-Kivu -- once -- and persisted in its stream by forward
# fill. The front page of the same report states the membership in words.
# An entry asserts what the PAGE says a row belongs to. `province` may be
# `none`, meaning the page assigns the row to no province (a national pool
# row); such rows stay out of every province series and inside the national
# identity. Hash-keyed like every register: a revised document returns for a
# fresh judgement.
# COLUMNS
#   sitrep      report number
#   date        data date, from the page's Date de rapportage
#   sha256_16   first 16 hex characters of the PDF's SHA-256
#   zone        the row's printed name (folded matching)
#   province    what the page assigns it to, or `none`
#   verified_by who read the page, and against what
#   note        where on the page the assignment is stated
sitrep
